title: The Golden Android's Mirage
story: In a high-tech utopian metropolis, Alex navigates neon luxury clubs among 45+ socialites with her tall long-haired love interest. A menacing evil humanoid robot stalks them; when her back turns, corruption warps him. At climax the robot forces a tragic transformation that reframes him as a majestic chrome and obsidian-gold cybernetic companion.
style_lock: COMBINED: mature sophisticated graphic novel (rich ink washes, cross-hatch shading, charcoal texture, atmospheric lighting) PLUS Magnific modern pop-art energy (thick clean ink boundary profiles, saturated cyan/magenta/bright yellow accents, subtle Ben-Day/halftone on skin and sky). Anamorphic 35mm cinematic feel, widescreen lens flares, elegant elongated human proportions with lengthened legs. Absolutely NO comic text, speech bubbles, or onomatopoeia (no WHOOSH/POW/BOOM).

characters.alex: Hero/Alex — fierce protagonist, long voluminous wavy golden-orange hair, studded black motorcycle leather jacket, sharp expressive eyes, elegant elongated proportions
characters.love_interest_human: Tall incredibly handsome pretty man with long flowing hair, charming grin, elegant body, stylized buckled combat boots
characters.evil_robot: Menacing high-risk evil humanoid robot / mechanical shell with terrifying grin, dark metallic energy
characters.companion_android: Strikingly handsome very tall humanoid android, polished chrome and brushed obsidian-gold finish, majestic low-angle presence
characters.crowd: Massive crowd of 45+ distinct utopian cityscape socialites / elite lounge characters
